title: The Nyborg app opens: your Nyborgs at /arena/play/
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: The Nyborg app has a home at /arena/play/. It opens on your Nyborgs: your favourite in the spotlight with a Race button and a Tank button, and every other Nyborg as a card you can tap.
A first visit hatches your first Nyborg in one screen: a name, a hairdo and a colour. Then it's two clicks to watching it race the house drivers or take on the house tank.
next: Named house Nyborgs and one match setup for both arenas.
